note: Word counts are measured by ../_tools/check_runs.py (words outside fenced code blocks). It is independent of the skill's own script.

evals.prompt: caveman mode. how do I undo my last commit? already pushed to main, teammates pulled it. Write your answer to reply.md in the working folder, exactly as you would say it to me.
assertions: [script] The answer contains the git revert command
[script] At most 60 words outside code blocks
[judge] The commands are exact, copyable and in a code block, including the push
[judge] It warns against, or clearly rules out, reset plus force-push on the shared branch
[judge] Nothing a reader needs to act safely is missing, and nothing is wrong
[judge] No greeting, no restating of the question, no closing offer

evals.prompt: terse mode. orders-api/ keeps dying under load, the log is in orders-api/logs/error.log. why, and what's the fix? Write your answer to reply.md in the working folder, exactly as you would say it to me.
assertions: [script] The exact error text 'sorry, too many clients already' is quoted
[script] At most 90 words outside code blocks
[judge] The root cause is right: a new connection pool is created on every request (routes/orders.js line 7 via getPool) and never closed
[judge] The cause is tied to a file and line
[judge] The fix is given as code: one shared pool created once
[judge] No filler, hedging or restating of the question

evals.prompt: Be terse from now on. Give me the steps to rotate the production Postgres password for our app with zero downtime. The app reads DATABASE_URL from env; 3 app servers behind a load balancer; one DB role today (app_user). Write your answer to reply.md in the working folder, exactly as you would say it to me.
assertions: [script] At most 150 words outside code blocks
[judge] The order is safe: a new working credential exists before the old one is touched, and servers are restarted one at a time
[judge] The step that removes or invalidates the old credential is marked as the point of no return, with a check to run before it
[judge] That warning is written as a complete, unambiguous sentence rather than clipped fragments
[judge] SQL and commands are exact and copyable
